narr: Monsoon moisture fueled scattered thunderstorms over southeast California. Many storms produced flash flooding, and a few produced severe weather.
ev: Highway 95 was flooded, and at least one vehicle was stuck in the water.
Ten to 15 vehicles were stuck between two flooded areas on Highway 95 just north of Vidal Junction.
Highway 190 was flooded between Furnace Creek and Cow Creek.
Highway 190 was flooded in several areas west of Death Valley Junction. The water was about a foot deep and carried a significant amount of debris.
Interstate 15 was closed due to flooding between Bailey Road and Nipton Road. The highway, onramps, and offramps were also flooded at Yates Well Road.
A vehicle was stuck on Highway 62 in flash flooding, eventually leading to the closure of the highway.
The intersection of Rodgers Lane and Meldora Ave was flooded.
